channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Why has Trump halted Iran attacks, and what is the deal he is hinting at?
item.description: Trump says 'perimeters of a deal has been agreed to' as he pauses attacks. But is there any substance to his claim?

item.title: Trump ‘cancels attack on Iran’ saying deal is near
item.description: US President Trump announced he was cancelling a planned attack on Iran with the ‘perimeters of a deal’ agreed to.

item.title: At least three dead in Idaho shopping mall mass shooting
item.description: Police said at least three people were killed several others were wounded in a shooting at an In-N-Out Burger in Idaho.

item.title: Trump cancels Iran strikes subject to deal being made 'rapidly'
item.description: The US president claims Iran and other Middle Eastern countries asked Washington to hold off on any attack as the "perimeters" of a deal had been agreed.

item.title: Three killed after bomb detonated at Moscow restaurant, state media say
item.description: Security officials said a woman tried to enter the restaurant with explosives but was stopped by a security guard.

item.title: Israeli West Bank settler tells BBC attacks on Palestinians are justified as revenge
item.description: Settler violence against Palestinians is on the rise in the West Bank, as settlements and outposts expand.

item.title: Current Ebola outbreak worst ever in DR Congo, WHO says
item.description: The current strain has so far killed 1,587 people, and there is currently no approved vaccine or treatment.

item.title: Bowen: Plan for Hamas to disarm faces big obstacles, yet it offers rare hope for Gaza
item.description: The realities of politics, war, zero trust, the deaths of thousands and the destruction of Gaza will make any agreement very complicated.
